candidates.change_summary: Replace the require that sender is owner with require that sender is NOT owner, allowing only non-owners to call sendTo, changing transfer observable behavior.
Remove the ownership check so any caller can invoke sendTo, changing who can trigger transfers and thus observable behavior.
Change the transfer target from the provided receiver to the transaction sender, altering which address receives funds and observable state relating to sendTo effects.
Change the transfer amount to send the contract's entire balance instead of the requested amount, altering post-call balances observed via sendTo effects.
Invert the non-zero amount check to require amount == 0, causing behavior to differ by accepting only zero transfers (which will revert), changing observable outcome.
